name: Threat from Below

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you help defend Horde-held territory from encroaching naga scouts. Horde grunts will watch for stragglers.

faq.answer: You are sent to slay naga scouts who have begun raising camps nearby. Bring back naga spinefins as proof that you struck the encroaching serpentfolk.
The snakes, or snake scum, are naga: amphibious serpentine humanoids who have emerged from coastal or aquatic depths to scout local positions.
faq.q: Who are the snakes mentioned in the orders?

faq.answer: Their camps point to an organized scouting effort, not wandering creatures. The local commander wants swift retaliation before the naga can mount a larger assault or strengthen their position.
faq.q: Why must the naga scouts be eliminated?

faq.answer: Naga spinefins provide physical proof that the scout camps were found and broken. They confirm that the immediate pressure along the border has eased.
The commander hopes the strike will send surviving naga north. Grunts will watch for stragglers and suspicious movements.
faq.q: Where are the naga expected to retreat?

faq.answer: Horde grunts are ordered to watch the area for stragglers and further naga incursions.
faq.q: Who keeps watch after the scouts are slain?

sections.body: Naga raiders have begun raising camps nearby. Local defenders send you to strike before the intruders gain a foothold. You are to slay the scouts and bring back naga spinefins as proof that their camp has been crushed.
sections.title: Serpentine Incursion

sections.body: The serpentfolk have troubled the area before, and local command will not abide their presence. After you strike the scout camps, surviving naga are expected to flee north. Horde grunts will watch for stragglers and sudden ambushes.
sections.title: Securing the Borders

summary: Naga scouts are raising camps nearby, and Threat from Below sends you against them. Horde defenders hope to drive the invaders north and keep the area safe.
attribution: In-game quest text: Threat from Below
